title: Choice-independent run length
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine and let $N$ be its associated nondeterministic machine, whose two choice transitions both equal the transition of $M$. For every input word, configuration $c$ on that input, and finite choice word $w$, running $N$ from $c$ under $w$ gives the same configuration as running $M$ from $c$ for $|w|$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Its associated nondeterministic machine uses the deterministic transition for either choice
A finite input word and configuration on that input
A finite word of Boolean choices
replaced:
Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with transition function $\delta$, and
let $N$ be the nondeterministic machine with the same initial state whose two transition
functions both equal $\delta$.  For every configuration $c$ on a fixed input and every
choice word $w \in \{0,1\}^*$, the run of $N$ from $c$ under $w$ equals the configuration
reached by running $M$ from $c$ for $|w|$ steps.
